content.description: Bone cancer is a critical health issue, particularly for adolescents and young adults, with diagnostic delays significantly increasing mortality. Current health education tools lack engaging resources like serious games specifically for bone cancer. This paper addresses this gap by presenting CancerSB, a serious adventure game developed to provide culturally grounded, interactive education on bone cancer, aiming to improve awareness and support early detection.
